name: Hitori Korosu no mo Futari Korosu no mo Onaji Koto da to Omou kara
original_name: 1人殺すのも2人殺すのも同じことだと思うから
source:
In January, Misuzu loses her house and mother to a fire. Because of that, she has to transfer schools in the third semester. Living alone. A new town, a new school, new friends. Full of anxiety, Misuzu's new life begins.

[Translated from [url=http://groneko.web.fc2.com/12/1.html]official website[/url]]
translation:
一月，弥铃在一场火灾中失去了家与母亲，不得不在第三学期转学。独自生活，陌生的城镇，陌生的学校，新的朋友。怀着满心不安，弥铃的新生活开始了。

[译自[url=http://groneko.web.fc2.com/12/1.html]官方网站[/url]]
